contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Counterparty Risk job leads the establishment and implementation of the global counterparty risk strategy, portfolio and processes including credit and accounts receivable activities to mitigate potential risks and support the organization's financial security, with a mid- to long-term impact on business results. This job manages a major department or sub-function responsible for providing visibility of key credit exposures and risks to support strategic decisions and ensuring the implementation of effective processes and efficient structures to measure risks and generate insights. The job also performs fiduciary governance activities on behalf of the company’s risk committee and leads the credit risk subcommittee by providing visibility of credit exposures to key stakeholders including the chief financial officer, the corporate controller, enterprise finance leads, the executive leadership team and business group leaders.
contents.key_account:
• Counterparty Risk Strategy: Leads the establishment and implementation of the global counterparty risk strategy to govern and support the management of credit risk across the organization, developing the global vision for service delivery, defining and governing the global service catalog, and developing and applying a differentiated service strategy globally.
  • Counterparty Analysis Effectiveness: Directs the establishment and implementation of effective credit standards, policies, procedures and limits, and ensures credit mitigation tools are used appropriately to provide actionable credit risk insights to support decision making and enable an integrated operating approach for the organization.
  • Credit Exposure & Risk Assessment: Oversees credit exposures and credit limit breaches and partners with leadership to make trade off decisions by promoting prudent risk taking, optimal sizing and dynamic management of exposures to maximize risk reward potential and assuring the appropriate rigor and assessment are applied to any credit loss and that appropriate corrective measures are taken.
  • Credit Management Improvement: Provides strategic direction to identify opportunities to improve the management of credit exposure across the organization including options to better mitigate financial exposures and risk, and brings external learnings to expand credit risk perspectives, advance credit risk management practices, share best practices among the risk community and identify and execute on synergies between credit and market risk to promote integrated approaches.
  • Framework & Model Development: Directs the development and implementation of risk assessment frameworks and models, including robust credit risk quantification, appropriated metrics and credit risk dashboards, to evaluate counterparty credit risk and ensure reserves are identified, quantified and reported.
  • Credit Process Approach: Leads the establishment and implementation of an optimal credit process approach and delivery model across the organization, driving consistency and achieving industry leading efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Business Partnership: Directs the relationships with counterparties and other business partners including customers, suppliers, businesses, broad risk management teams, other internal enterprises and functions.
  • Team Management: Manages team members to achieve the organization’s goals, by ensuring productivity, communicating performance expectations, creating goal alignment, giving and seeking feedback, providing coaching, measuring progress and holding people accountable, supporting employee development, recognizing achievement and lessons learned, and developing enabling conditions for talent to thrive in an inclusive team culture.

contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Managerial Accounting job leads the establishment and implementation of the global financial analyses strategy, including financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, to enable strategic business decision making and business performance measurements, with a mid- to long-term impact on business results. This job leads and guides a major department or sub-function responsible for generating and presenting critical financial insights to support business decisions, financial analysis and forecasting. The job is the primary contact for financial information on business performance in business operations leadership team
contents.key_account:
• Reporting Management: Leads the establishment and implementation of global financial analyses framework, governance, process and capability to deliver accurate and timely presentation of both financial and nonfinancial reports for internal stakeholders, ensuring reporting standards best meet the needs of business leaders.
  • Business Performance Management: Leads global business performance management processes, including identifying and reviewing key performance indicators and metrics across all businesses, such as inventory, to draw insights and inform recommendations to business leaders.
  • Decision Support: Provides strategic direction for financial analyses and research and key insights communication to support strategic business decision making.
  • Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strategic relationships with key business leaders to understand business needs and drive strategic business improvements.
  • Process Development: Leads the establishment and ensure successful implementation of global financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes.

contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Tax job establishes and implements all aspects of tax activity strategies, with a mid to long-term impact on business results. This job directs and leads a major department or sub-function responsible for the execution of tax compliance, the development of tax solutions, and resolving audits
contents.key_account:
• Tax Compliance Activity Oversight: Plans, advises, and controls the tax compliance strategies and activities for the organization, directing the team responsible for statutory and/or U.S. GAAP accounting for all tax items, ensuring key filing positions are supported by appropriate documentation, and overseeing the preparation of tax returns, tax forms, and related documents associated with tax compliance.
  • Tax Compliance Process Development and Improvement: Guides the development and implementation of policies and tax compliance processes, reviews and approves the development of processes and data requirements for tax/financial/compliance-related systems, and directs the team's analyses to determine tax and work process issues in practice.
  • Developing Tax Solutions: Leads and guides the development and implementation of technical tax planning solutions to optimize the organization's tax liabilities and risks, including strategy, planning and modeling with respect to corporate and capital structure, financing and repatriation strategy, trading and risk management.
  • Providing Tax Counsel: Fosters relationships with and provides advice and training for senior leadership, and identifies training opportunities and creates proposal for tax employees to enhance general tax education.
  • Tax Research, Analysis and Strategic Planning: Supports strategic tax objective planning, sets priorities and identifies resource needs, and oversees and reviews tax-related research and analysis for the purpose of completing tax compliance responsibilities.
  • Audit Strategy and Conducting Audits: Drives the development of audit defense strategies, oversees most complex risk audits and responses to information requests from external taxing authorities, and manages relationships and communications with external revenue bodies and/or inquiries from various taxing authorities.

contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Tax Process job establishes and implements global tax process, data, and technology strategies to drive tax operations with a mid to long-term impact on business results. This job oversees a team responsible for modernizing and deploying tax controls across tax, finance, and other functions while leading efforts to optimize application data and architecture, driving continuous improvement. This job provides strategic direction to a major department or sub-function, ensuring the deployment of compliance programs to meet local governmental requirements for compliance, reporting and audits and governs the migration and operation of tax compliance activities within the organization’s service centers or outsourced providers.
contents.key_account:
• Tax Operation and Product Development Technology Strategy: Leads the development and execution of a comprehensive program to segment, prioritize, and implement all aspects of tax operations and product development technology strategies globally across all tax types, and applies continuous improvement processes to automate workflows where feasible and adapts strategies based on legislative, technological, and business changes.
  • Tax Legal Requirements and Strategy: Understands current and anticipates future global and local tax legal requirements, assessing their impact on operations and tax product development technology strategies, and guides the design of efficient tax processes and programs to ensure compliance, reporting and audit requirements are met across all tax types and countries.
  • Control Framework Design: Leads the design of end-to-end control frameworks for each tax type based on global templates adapted to meet the specific regulatory requirements and risks of each country.
  • Control Framework Execution: Establishes the operating model for framework implementation, using internal functions, groups and global audits, and selects the target tax architecture for operations, including data storage and enrichment for associated processes.
  • Control Framework Direction and Improvement: Guides the identification and deployment of the data analytics required and the target architecture to support the frameworks and the solutions needed to control identified gaps.
  • Data Analytics Deployment: Guides the identification and deployment of an optimal data collection source and the required data enrichment for each tax type, and the design and deployment of efficient data analytics to support both the control framework and tax compliance, reporting and audit operations.

contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Trade Compliance job leads the establishment and implementation of comprehensive internal import and export controls and governance activities to ensure compliance with all trade-related regulations, with a mid to long term impact on business results. This job provides strategic leadership to a major department responsible for ensuring international business activities are compliant with relevant regulatory requirements. Additionally, this job is responsible for overseeing audits, and implementing training programs to drive the effectiveness of internal trade controls.
contents.key_account:
• Policy and Procedure Development: Champions the development and implementation of global trade compliance programs, policies and procedures, applying knowledge of relevant customs and trade-related laws, regulations, practices and procedures to ensure adherence to applicable laws and regulations.
  • Business Process Improvement: Leads team to monitor, review and improve business compliance processes at both regional and global levels, and approves strategic direction for customs related activities across the organization, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and business units.
  • Solution Development: Directs the development and implementation of complex and technical customs planning solutions in order to capture significant customs benefits and mitigate risks globally by leading strategic planning and modeling of trading, trade flow and risk management activity.
  • Expert Advising: Advises senior management and business leaders to provide information and guidance on customs aspects of key business plans and strategy in support of achieving the organization's objectives.
  • Audit Oversight: Manages high risk audits and responds to information requests from external customs authorities, and oversees audit defense strategies and best practices by identifying potential compliance risks and developing strategies to mitigate these risks.
  • Relationship Management: Leads the development and management of relationships with appropriate government agencies to stay informed of regulatory updates.
  • Metrics Analysis: Champions the analysis of trade compliance metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement.
  • Compliance Training: Identifies and approves strategic training opportunities, and oversees the design and implementation of training programs aimed at educating employees on trade compliance requirements and best practices.
  • Team Management: Manages team members to achieve the organization’s goals, by ensuring productivity, communicating performance expectations, creating goal alignment, giving and seeking feedback, providing coaching, measuring progress and holding people accountable, supporting employee development, recognizing achievement and lessons learned, and developing enabling conditions for talent to thrive in an inclusive team culture.

  • Manages Financial Risk: Identifies, assesses, communicates, educates, and mitigates financial risks and potential consequences to the business; understands and monitors robust control frameworks
  • Conducts Complex Financial Analyses: Conducts complex financial analyses (e.g., forecasting, scenario planning, cost/benefit analysis, and modeling), critically interprets and models the results, and distills and translates the data points into actionable business insights and decision making
  • Manages Allocation of Assets: Manages Cargill’s financial assets, liabilities, and cash flows to ensure liquidity, stability, and efficiency of financial operations for the organization
  • Reports Financial Information: Gathers, analyzes, understands, and interprets various types of financial information, both internally and externally, in a way that promotes the financial health and sustainability of the organization.

contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Capital Markets & Trading job leads the establishment and implementation of the organization's funding and foreign exchange strategy and global risk-taking treasury market group business, with a mid- to long-term impact on business results to ensure that the organization has access to the necessary funds, manage currency risks, optimize costs, and comply with regulatory requirements. This role oversees the short- and long-term funding books and cross-border funding structures across the organization. This job manages a major department or sub-function responsible for meeting the daily funding needs of all business groups and maintaining the organization's foreign exchange flow.
contents.key_account:
• Strategy & Execution: Leads the global foreign exchange flow and hedging execution desks, the global foreign exchange flow model and design, and the global long term debt book, including balance sheet management, fixed float mix, net investment hedging and debt substitution decisions, supporting global businesses and ensuring alignment with the global treasury markets strategy.
  • Global Funding Strategy: Plans global funding patterns, partners with tax stakeholders to determine strategy for global cash flow positioning through the global treasury hubs, and manages the global cashflow forecasting and planning in partnership with treasury advisory.
  • Organizational Alignment: Drives alignment between the organization's long-term debt management practices, including planning and executing all debt issuances, managing the fixed float mix and balance sheet, and overseeing net investment hedge exposures.
  • Risk Management: Leads the risk taking book and oversees risk positions in foreign exchange and interest rate markets.
  • Relationship Management: Fosters and leads funding bank relationships, leads global foreign exchange relationships, and ensures reciprocity is maintained and aligned with the relationship group and that banks follow through on pricing agreements.
  • Team Management: Manages team members to achieve the organization’s goals, by ensuring productivity, communicating performance expectations, creating goal alignment, giving and seeking feedback, providing coaching, measuring progress and holding people accountable, supporting employee development, recognizing achievement and lessons learned, and developing enabling conditions for talent to thrive in an inclusive team culture.

contents.purpose: The Senior Manager I, Treasury Advisory job leads the establishment and implementation of treasury advisory strategies and initiatives with a mid- to long-term impact on business results. This job directs the development and implementation of policies and procedures that align with organizational goals and contribute to the organization's overall financial well-being. This job manages a major department or sub-function responsible for providing treasury advisory services including analyzing financial data, identifying risks, and developing strategies to mitigate risk.
contents.key_account:
• Treasury Strategy Development: Leads the development and implementation of the organization's treasury advisory strategy to ensure risk management and treasury advisory expertise is provided to the organization, and directs global initiatives to develop new strategies or revise existing strategies to improve the organization's treasury practices, strategic projects, and overall financial well-being.
  • Financial Policy Design: Leads the organization in the design of treasury-related financial policies and procedures and recommends corporate policy changes, such as foreign exchange, financing, joint venture, leasing and balance sheet management.
  • Relationship Management: Acts as the global focal point for banks who serve the organization globally, in order to ensure adequate credit and service access to the bank market.
  • Advising: Leads and oversees treasury advisory core projects related to mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and joint ventures, including due diligence, financing, structuring, planning, and integration.
  • Business Partnership: Ensures delivery of world-class treasury advisory services by collaborating with key business stakeholders to develop understanding of needs and problems and provide high quality treasury services, in addition to education regarding treasury-related risks and financing alternatives.
  • Process Review & Improvement: Ensures understanding of regulatory environment and applies learnings to minimize the organization's regulatory and financial risks, champions continuous improvement by ensuring treasury operations are efficient, well-controlled, and aligned with business objectives, and oversees the development of new processes and guidelines when improvements are needed.

This job leads and guides the team responsible for supporting the organization's financial health through the implementation of robust credit controls and policies.

  • Credit Analysis: Provides strategic direction for credit analyses and insights generation on credit trends, profitability, economics, and collections activities to ensure credit decisions are adequately informed.
  • Credit Standards: Leads the establishment and successful implementation of credit control policies and procedures, ensuring effective and efficient credit standards, policies, procedures, and controls are in place and aligned throughout the organization to minimize credit risks, optimize cash flow management, and align with industry standards.

This job also serves as lead credit risk partner for the organization, leading global improvement efforts, strategic credit initiatives and review of large limits, collaboration with the market risk team on measurement and market risk and market trends, and providing periodic updates to financial stakeholders on key credit risks and progress on initiatives.
contents.key_account:
• Counterparty Analysis Effectiveness: Leads the implementation of effective credit standards, policies, processes and procedures for counterparty risk, including an analysis of credit portfolios to assess the potential impact of key risks, and leads the design and implementation of risk assessment frameworks and models to ensure counterparty credit risk quantification, appropriated metrics and credit risk thresholds.
  • Credit Exposure & Risk Assessment: Reviews and assesses credit exposures and credit limit breaches and provides leadership insights on appropriate credit view that highlights key credit risk and exposures.
  • Credit Management Improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve the management of credit exposure across the organization including options to mitigate financial exposures and risk.
  • Credit Process Approach: Ensures all credit process approach and delivery model within the business, proactively managing the alignment of risk policies by collaborating with internal trade and credit risk leadership and aligning to the corporate approach.
  • Business Partnerships: Develops and maintains strong relationships with counterparties and stakeholders across the organization, including suppliers, businesses, broad risk management teams, and finance leaders.
  • Team Management: Manages team members to achieve the organization’s goals, by ensuring productivity, communicating performance expectations, creating goal alignment, giving and seeking feedback, providing coaching, measuring progress and holding people accountable, supporting employee development, recognizing achievement and lessons learned, and developing enabling conditions for talent to thrive in an inclusive team culture.

contents.purpose: The Manager I, Cost Accounting job leads the team responsible for the execution of the tactical and strategic plans related to all aspects of cost accounting operations within the organization, including cost analysis, inventory valuation, and cost control. This job provides leadership and oversight to the team responsible for analyzing cost data to provide business leaders with strategic recommendations to optimize cost efficiency and inform decision-making. This job adopts and develops tactical and strategic plans to ensure achievement of the global vision/strategy, provides domain expertise, and drives complex optimization activities in partnership with other leaders to promote change. This job also acts as a key partner in understanding and issues resolution issues in a complex matrix environment. This job maintains alignment with global processing process requirements and expectations to deliver standard costing objectives, works to deliver efficient end-to-end costing process, and provides leadership for the design of product cost and end-to-end process, ensuring accuracy of cost capture, allocation and absorption to inventory/COGS to analyze cost results.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Project Accounting job provides moderately complex financial support and analysis for the organization’s projects. Under limited supervision, this job supports all financial activities in projects including project cost analysis, billing, and revenue. This job collaborates with project teams and controller teams to ensure project financials are accurately accounted and adherence to project budgets by monitoring project expenses, preparing accurate financial reports, and providing valuable insights to resolve accounting issues.
contents.key_account:
• Project Budget Development: Collaborates with project teams to ensure generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) compliance, project cost breakdown and process adherence.
  • Financial Analysis: Analyzes project financial data, including costs, revenues, and expenses, to identify trends, variances, and potential risks.
  • Financial Reporting: Delivers accurate and timely financial reports, including project cost estimates, forecasts, and actuals to support project decision-making.
  • Expense Monitoring: Monitors project expenses and adherence to approved budgets, identifying and addressing any deviations or cost overruns.
  • Project Cost Optimization: Conducts moderately complex financial reviews and provides recommendations to optimize project costs, improve profitability, and mitigate financial risks.
  • Problem Resolution: Investigates the method for root cause analysis, participates in the investigation, and provides recommendations for resolution.
  • Implement Corporate & Local Policies: Communicates, educates and implements corporate and local accounting policies and procedures, including mentoring and training personnel, developing closure of project financials and other functions as necessary.
  • Month-End Activities: Performs all month-end activities to close financial books.
  • Project Closure: Ensures accurate classification of costs, on time capitalization, and adherence to policies by having strong knowledge, and collaborating with business and controller teams to ensure timely closure of project financials.
  • Industry Expertise: Stays abreast of industry regulations and accounting standards, ensuring compliance and supporting continuous improvement.
contents.finance_technical:
• Makes Decisions with Key Financial Information: Understands key financial information to support the creation of budgets and inform effective business decision-making.
  • Upholds Tax & Regulatory Standards: Supports Cargill’s tax-related strategies through knowledge of laws, regulations, and practices.
  • Manages Financial Risk: Supports Cargill’s risk management strategies to inform decision-making, safeguard assets, and prevent errors in support of the business.
  • Conducts Complex Financial Analyses: Supports Cargill’s use of business insights and effective decision-making through executing and interpreting complex financial analyses.
  • Manages Allocation of Assets: Supports the management of financial assets, liabilities, and cash flows within Cargill.
  • Reports Financial Information: Supports the collection and analysis of financial information from internal and external sources for financial reporting.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Tax job independently prepares tax forms and performs moderately complex tax research and analysis, and tax compliance activities. Under limited supervision, this job collaboratively develops tax solutions and advice and the resolution of legal disputes and audits.
contents.key_account:
• Tax Returns and Tax Form Completion: Prepares moderately complex tax returns, and prepares and reviews tax forms and related documents associated with tax compliance, including provisions, computations, estimates, and extensions.
  • Tax Compliance and Inquiry Responses: Provides support to the organization’s subsidiaries, joint ventures, business staff and department personnel by responding to moderately complex tax inquiries and tax transactions issues.
  • Tax Compliance Activities: Participates on tax compliance projects, and oversees and monitors tax/financial/compliance systems for troubleshooting, training, and draft quality purposes, and oversees and executes general processes related to statutory and U.S. GAAP accounting for regulated entities.
  • Tax Compliance Process Improvement: Reviews and audits businesses to correctly follow compliance processes, analyzes compliance processes and/or the applications used in these processes to draw conclusions and recommend enhancements to increase and ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of compliance processes.
  • Developing Tax Solutions: Identifies gaps and provides recommendations to optimize the organization’s tax liabilities and risks, and implements corporate tax planning ideas and process-improvement initiatives, including ownership, compliance reporting, MADJV funding, funding and risk management.
  • Providing Tax Counsel: Communicates with and provides advice to business staff and managers, including details around implementation of tax planning solutions and trainings.
  • Tax Research and Analysis: Conducts moderately complex tax-related research and analysis for the purpose of completing tax compliance responsibilities.
  • Conducting Audits and Resolving Legal Disputes: Develops responses to routine audits and information requests from external taxing authorities for verification from taxing authorities and information requests from external tax authorities, and handles routine correspondence with external revenue bodies and/or inquiries from taxing authorities.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Tax Compliance job develops and implements moderately complex income tax compliance and global tax accounting, including financial statement reporting activities. With limited supervision, this job develops and executes tax compliance process, supports the implementation of innovative processes, analyzes planning initiatives and enables the resolution of tax disputes while adhering to legislative and regulatory standards.
contents.key_account:
• Tax Filing Compliance: Implements timely and accurate fulfillment of moderately complex company’s income tax filing obligations and performs tax compliance tasks, tax returns and related documents to ensure key filing positions are supported by appropriate documentation.
  • Financial Statement Reporting: Implements moderately complex financial statement reporting of tax matters under U.S. GAAP and analyzes income tax disclosures to compliance and accounting.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Partners collaboratively with key teams to support effective communications on tax accounting issues.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Supports collaboration with tax and non-tax teams to ensure they understand the impact of tax accounting on their business objectives.
  • Strategic Planning and Legislative Partnership: Implements moderately complex planning initiatives, performs tax compliance analysis and partners with other tax teams on legislative and regulatory developments.
  • Operational Excellence: Implements operational excellence and continuous improvement activities in tax accounting and compliance processes to ensure audit tasks effectiveness.
  • Tax Compliance Process Development and Improvement: Reviews and guides businesses to follow compliance process, supports implementation of global policies and specific processes, participates in tax compliance projects, and also supports data requirements for tax, financial, compliance-related systems.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Customs Advisory job implements and supports development of customs regulatory and advisory activities in a region. Under limited supervision, this job implements and maintains moderately complex customs solutions and processes, while focusing on continuous improvement and adhering to import and export customs regulations, supports legal disputes and audits, and analyzes moderately complex trade matters. This job applies general knowledge to support the development of customs compliance policies and handles customs issues and regulations.
contents.key_account:
• Policy and Procedure Development: Implements, maintains and supports development of moderately complex customs solutions, planning, compliance policies, and procedures to adhere to applicable laws and regulations.
  • Expert Advisory: Uses general knowledge to provide support to key partners to ensure compliance with customs regulations and trade policies to mitigate impacts to the organization, and applies recommendations on local and regional trade and regulatory matters including tariffs classifications, country of origin determinations, and regulated product flows.
  • Customs Strategies: Collaborates with global and regional stakeholders and other business leaders to implement and optimize global customs strategies and ensure requirements are met.
  • Audits and Remissions: Supports process improvements for the resolution of moderately complex disputes and audits, including customs audits, investigations, and remissions.
  • Metrics Analysis: Analyzes data and customs compliance metrics to provide insights while identifying optimal customs data.
  • Compliance Partnership: Partners with legal counsel and customs authorities as necessary for the resolution of regulatory updates and best practices to deliver high quality services in support of the reputation for adherence to import and export customs regulations.
  • Compliance Training: Supports the design and implementation of training programs aimed at educating the team and stakeholders on customs compliance requirements and best practices.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Customs Excise Advisory job implements the compliance control frameworks for the general excise activities of businesses and participates in customs regulation projects within the assigned region. Under limited supervision, this job partners closely with business units to address risk and leverage excise and customs opportunities, implements the control and compliance improvements, contributes to responses to government inquiries and supports general operations. This job collaborates with other initiatives to identify cost reduction, cost avoidance and cost recovery opportunities.
contents.key_account:
• Strategic Planning and Advisory Initiatives: Supports excise strategic planning and advisory initiatives, performs general consultation on business projects, excise licenses, permits and registrations.
  • Issue Resolution: Partners to resolve moderately complex issues related to excise declarations, stock shrinkages and losses.
  • Audits and Investigation: Performs moderately complex excise audits and governmental investigations in alignment with other audit initiatives.
  • Excise Tax Control Framework: Executes the excise tax control framework for the assigned region and provides the defined processes, monitors legislation for products covered by the excise control framework and implements updated compliance processes.
  • Global Trade Compliance Governance: Collaborates with other global trade compliance professionals and businesses within the organization to support proper understanding of roles and responsibilities and provides governance of the global trade compliance excise operating model.
  • Data Management Framework: Participates in the development of processes to govern excise data monitoring and reporting for internal and external purposes.
  • Excise Technology Strategy: Supports the deployment of technologies and various activities involved in their implementation within the assigned region, including requirements gathering, user testing and training.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Trade Compliance Operations job is responsible for executing moderately complex global trade compliance operations activities and supporting trade compliance projects. Under limited supervision, this job coordinates global trade and compliance transactions, ensures compliance, and collaborates to drive continuous improvement in support of the business strategy and objectives.
contents.key_account:
• Operational Execution: Coordinates global trade and compliance operations activities within a country or region in support of business goals, including executing global trade and coordinating import and export transactions with business strategy and objectives, and validating complete cross-border filings and clearance.
  • Transaction Auditing: Conducts regular audits and assessments of trade transactions to ensure compliance with import/export regulations, customs requirements, and trade agreements.
  • Documentation Review: Analyzes and ensures trade documents, including invoices, preferential trade documentation, shipping documents, export licenses, and other cross-border documents are accurate, complete, and in compliance with legal and fiscal requirements, and that records are maintained according to guidelines.
  • Relationship Management: Maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders and partners to implement cross-border trade solutions.
  • Metrics Analysis: Performs analysis of key performance indicators and performs moderately complex analyses for compliance operations in the designated location to evaluate process improvements.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contributes to the execution of internal global trade and compliance projects as needed for process enhancements or policy improvements.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Trade Compliance Excellence job is responsible for executing strategic moderately complex plans related to ongoing optimization and improvements in trade compliance. Under limited supervision, this job implements continuous improvement for trade compliance processes while also supporting high-quality advisory services internally. This job implements and supports the development of strategic trade compliance solutions and sensitized data strategies for the benefit of the business’ global trade operations.
contents.key_account:
• Solution Development: Develops moderately complex technical international compliance planning solutions to assimilate customs benefits and support risk mitigation, applying knowledge of trade compliance and industry best practices to support cross border solutions that meet the organization’s business.
  • Process Improvement: Performs investigation and assessment of trade compliance operations, agreement opportunities, and gaps in procedure to implement new trade compliance processes and best practices to support resolution of moderately complex trade compliance issues and comply with laws and regulations administered by government agencies.
  • Compliance Operations & Sensitized Data Strategy: Implements moderately complex regional trade compliance operations, sensitized data management systems, and processes, developing and implementing a scalable framework of standards to secure and facilitate global trade.
  • Compliance Training: Supports development of training programs aimed at educating employees on global trade compliance operations and sensitized data management.
  • Relationship Management: Executes interactions with appropriate government agencies and internal stakeholders to deliver compliant processes in support of effective business operations.

contents.purpose: The Professional, Banking Connectivity job handles the implementation of the organization’s treasury global bank connectivity strategy to enable seamless and real-time exchange of financial data, transactions, and information between various systems and platforms. Under general supervision, this job applies treasury and connectivity knowledge to support and enable moderately complex bank interface deployments. This job works with banking partners and both internal and external stakeholders to understand and enhance banking products and industry interface solutions.
contents.key_account:
• System Implementation Support: Provides analysis and insights during system implementation, system upgrade, and bank replacement projects to improve project success and ensure proper understanding.
  • Identify Requirements: Partners with banks and internal stakeholders to identify treasury bank interface requirements for application deployments so that optimal connectivity is ensured.
  • Technology & Security Controls: Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate technology, security, and controls are implemented across treasury and corporate initiatives.
  • M&A Support: Provides bank interface-related expertise on regulatory changes, mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and divestitures to support related implementations of connectivity changes.
  • Connectivity Optimization: Supports treasury bank strategy-related initiatives to secure, standardize, and enhance optimal connectivity across the region.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contributes to interface requirements, troubleshoots technical problems, and defines new solutions to ensure the continued standardization and optimization of the organization’s bank interfaces.
